title: Exposure
description: One advisory that affects one component in one deployment, from the time it opened to the time it closed. Only a running observation of the fixed artifact closes an exposure as fixed; a decision, a confirmation by rule or a corrected match closes it for its own reason. `decision` is the analysis in CycloneDX 1.6 VEX terms.

aliases.description: Other identifiers of the same vulnerability.

candidate.description: The identifier of the fix candidate for this exposure, when there is one.

stage.title: ExposureStage
stage.description: How far the fix of an open exposure went. `detected`: matched, no fix yet. `confirmed_affected`: a rule confirmed the match. `fix_prepared`: a candidate exists. `candidate_rejected`: a person rejected the candidate. `approved`: every required role approved the candidate. `rolling_out`: a release with the fix moves through the rings. `awaiting_observation`: the release runs in the ring of the deployment, and no observation shows the fixed artifact yet. `rolled_back`: the release was rolled back in that ring.

closure.title: ExposureClosure
closure.description: Why the exposure closed. `fixed_observed`: a running observation shows the fixed artifact. `fixed_confirmed`: a rule confirmed that the running build contains the fix. `not_affected`: a person decided that the component is not affected. `risk_accepted`: a person accepted the risk until a date. `withdrawn`: the same artifact no longer matches, so the match was wrong.

decision.title: ExposureDecision
decision.description: The analysis of the exposure, as a CycloneDX 1.6 vulnerability analysis, plus who decided and when an acceptance of risk lapses. The value `unknown` marks an input that a mapping did not recognize; CycloneDX has no such value.

decidedBy.description: The person who made the decision. Absent when a rule made it.

until.description: The date on which an acceptance of risk lapses and the exposure opens again.
